description: Environment setup and green baseline. Create the working branch, confirm the current main builds and smoke-tests green, confirm renovate.json validates against Renovate 44.61.6, and confirm every upstream checksum endpoint listed in context.json key_patterns is reachable and returns the exact value already committed in the Dockerfile. This establishes that any later failure is caused by our change and not by a pre-existing break or an unreachable upstream. No production file is modified in this feature.
steps: From /projects/sandbox/hermes-leo-config on branch main (HEAD 49089a6, clean), create and check out a working branch: `git checkout -b fix/renovate-checksum-sync`.

Validate the current Renovate config: `npx --yes --package renovate@44.61.6 renovate-config-validator renovate.json`. Record the full output including any WARN about config migration. Expect it to validate successfully today.

Confirm the five upstream checksum endpoints are reachable and return exactly the values currently committed in the Dockerfile. Use the URLs and JSON paths from context.json key_patterns verbatim. Expected: gws 0.22.5 -> de78ecdbd2f1a84cca0063a7ecbc440240fc14b6ebccbb17f4646b792a8c5c1f; gh 2.99.0 -> ed4960225d2833e04a61590d9fa2b5773d147f3aa375459e5466a40c102f3832; kubectl 1.37.0 -> 6129359f4e1f3848a5572ccb0b26cf28b8ca08cef38c95a765b2f64a2c961a2f; devin 3000.6.7 -> f88edacea692553910d72f275515bd0b52b5d271d55250981b0c41011142d27b; go 1.27.0 -> 675c26c449cbb18fc24b74650de1eabbae6e16f64326fd85a283fb3b58280685. Do NOT use https://go.dev/dl/go<V>.linux-amd64.tar.gz.sha256 for Go: that URL returns an HTML page. Use https://go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all.

Build the unmodified image to establish the baseline: `docker build -t hermes-leo-custom:baseline .`. The Go layer downloads ~300 MB so allow several minutes; use a generous command timeout rather than assuming a hang.

Run the five smoke commands from .github/workflows/pr-validation.yml against hermes-leo-custom:baseline: `docker run --rm --entrypoint gws --version`, `--entrypoint gh --version`, `--entrypoint kubectl version --client`, `--entrypoint devin --version`, `--entrypoint go version`. Record the version each tool reports.

Run the entrypoint and architecture assertions from the same workflow: `docker image inspect hermes-leo-custom:baseline --format '{{json .Config.Entrypoint}}'` must equal ["/opt/hermes/docker/entrypoint-dispatch.sh"] and `--format '{{.Architecture}}'` must equal amd64.

Write the recorded baseline output (validator result, the five confirmed checksums, the five reported tool versions, entrypoint and arch) into the `findings` field of this feature file so later features and the final review can compare against it.
Leave the working tree clean apart from files under .agents/. Do not commit any change to Dockerfile, renovate.json or the workflows in this feature.
acceptance_criteria: Branch fix/renovate-checksum-sync exists and is checked out.
`npx --yes --package renovate@44.61.6 renovate-config-validator renovate.json` reports 'Config validated successfully' with no ERROR lines, and any WARN output is recorded in findings.
All five upstream endpoints returned a value byte-identical to the checksum currently committed in the Dockerfile, and this is recorded in findings.
All five smoke commands exit 0 and their reported versions are recorded in findings.
Entrypoint equals ["/opt/hermes/docker/entrypoint-dispatch.sh"] and architecture equals amd64.
`git status --short` shows no modification to Dockerfile, renovate.json, or .github/workflows/.
verification: docker run --rm --entrypoint gws hermes-leo-custom:baseline --version && docker run --rm --entrypoint gh hermes-leo-custom:baseline --version && docker run --rm --entrypoint kubectl hermes-leo-custom:baseline version --client && docker run --rm --entrypoint devin hermes-leo-custom:baseline --version && docker run --rm --entrypoint go hermes-leo-custom:baseline version
docker image inspect hermes-leo-custom:baseline --format '{{json .Config.Entrypoint}}' && docker image inspect hermes-leo-custom:baseline --format '{{.Architecture}}'
findings:
GREEN BASELINE RECORDED on branch fix/renovate-checksum-sync (created from main @ 49089a6, clean). No production file modified.

1. RENOVATE CONFIG VALIDATOR — `npx --yes --package renovate@44.61.6 renovate-config-validator renovate.json` exit 0.
   Final line: ' INFO: Config validated successfully against 1 file(s)'. Zero ERROR lines.
   Two WARN lines, both about the pending config migration (already anticipated by context.json out_of_band_followups item (c)):
     - 'WARN: Config migration necessary' + full oldConfig/newConfig dump.
     - 'WARN: Config migration diff' showing exactly two changes: extends 'config:base' -> 'config:recommended', and customManagers[0].fileMatch ['^Dockerfile$'] -> managerFilePatterns ['/^Dockerfile$/'] (note the added slash delimiters in the migrated form).
   Consequence for FEAT-002: adopting the migrated spelling should make both WARNs disappear; the validator run in FEAT-002 must still end on 'Config validated successfully' with no ERROR.

2. UPSTREAM CHECKSUMS — all five endpoints reachable, all five values BYTE-IDENTICAL to what is committed in the Dockerfile today (verified by direct curl + jq, HEAD 49089a6):
     gws 0.22.5     -> de78ecdbd2f1a84cca0063a7ecbc440240fc14b6ebccbb17f4646b792a8c5c1f  (github.com/googleworkspace/cli releases, ...-x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu.tar.gz.sha256; body is 'sha256␠␠filename', two spaces, must be split on whitespace)
     gh 2.99.0      -> ed4960225d2833e04a61590d9fa2b5773d147f3aa375459e5466a40c102f3832  (gh_2.99.0_checksums.txt, line ending in gh_2.99.0_linux_amd64.tar.gz)
     kubectl 1.37.0 -> 6129359f4e1f3848a5572ccb0b26cf28b8ca08cef38c95a765b2f64a2c961a2f  (dl.k8s.io/release/v1.37.0/bin/linux/amd64/kubectl.sha256; bare hex, no filename, no trailing newline guarantee — trim it; it is the hash of the RAW BINARY, not of a tarball)
     devin 3000.6.7 -> f88edacea692553910d72f275515bd0b52b5d271d55250981b0c41011142d27b  (static.devin.ai/cli/3000.6.7/manifest.json, .platforms["x86_64-unknown-linux"].sha256)
     go 1.27.0      -> 675c26c449cbb18fc24b74650de1eabbae6e16f64326fd85a283fb3b58280685  (go.dev/dl/?mode=json&include=all, entry .version=="go1.27.0", file os=linux arch=amd64 kind=archive)
   Also captured for the FEAT-002 PR#26 simulation: go 1.27.1 -> 63d339f0da5ab53635a56f2490a7984dfe12dfcff22ad749f63edaf590168445 (same endpoint), which confirms context.json verification_instructions step 3.
   CONFIRMED BY EXECUTION: https://go.dev/dl/go1.27.1.linux-amd64.tar.gz.sha256 returns 'content-type: text/html; charset=utf-8' and a body starting '<!DOCTYPE html>' with a meta refresh to /dl/#... — NOT a hash. The sync script must use the ?mode=json endpoint; any .sha256-per-tarball assumption for Go would write HTML into GO_SHA256.

3. BASELINE BUILD — `docker build -t hermes-leo-custom:baseline .` exit 0 (BUILD_EXIT=0), 17 steps, image id 5ede1589354f. The five `sha256sum -c` gates all printed OK (/tmp/gh.tar.gz: OK, /tmp/kubectl: OK, /tmp/devin.tar.gz: OK, /tmp/go.tar.gz: OK; the gws layer was served from cache). Environment note: the local `docker` CLI is podman-backed (output uses 'STEP n/17' / 'COMMIT' and tags as localhost/hermes-leo-custom:baseline), so BuildKit-specific syntax must not be relied on locally even though CI uses docker/build-push-action with BuildKit.

4. FIVE SMOKE COMMANDS (exact commands from .github/workflows/pr-validation.yml), all exit 0:
     docker run --rm --entrypoint gws     hermes-leo-custom:baseline --version        -> 'gws 0.22.5' (+ 'This is not an officially supported Google product.')
     docker run --rm --entrypoint gh      hermes-leo-custom:baseline --version        -> 'gh version 2.99.0 (2026-09-01)'
     docker run --rm --entrypoint kubectl hermes-leo-custom:baseline version --client -> 'Client Version: v1.37.0' / 'Kustomize Version: v5.8.1'
     docker run --rm --entrypoint devin   hermes-leo-custom:baseline --version        -> 'devin 3000.6.7 (260a97c8)'
     docker run --rm --entrypoint go      hermes-leo-custom:baseline version          -> 'go version go1.27.0 linux/amd64'
   Harmless local-only noise on the first `docker run`: 'level=warning msg="Failed to add conmon to cgroupfs sandbox cgroup..."' (podman/cgroup sandbox artefact, not a build or image problem, exit code still 0).

5. ENTRYPOINT + ARCHITECTURE ASSERTIONS — both pass:
     docker image inspect --format '{{json .Config.Entrypoint}}' -> ["/opt/hermes/docker/entrypoint-dispatch.sh"] (equals expected)
     docker image inspect --format '{{.Architecture}}'           -> amd64 (equals expected)

6. WORKING TREE — `git status --short` shows only files under .agents/. Dockerfile, renovate.json and .github/workflows/ are untouched by this feature.

CONCLUSION: main is green today and every upstream checksum source in context.json key_patterns is reachable and authoritative. Any failure observed in FEAT-002 / FEAT-003 is therefore attributable to the change under test, not to a pre-existing break or an unreachable upstream. Trivy was NOT run locally (not installed in this sandbox and not required by this feature's acceptance criteria); the two Trivy steps remain CI-only verification.

BACKLOG STILL OPEN AFTER THIS FEATURE (nothing is blocked): FEAT-002 (remove the currentDigest capture group, add scripts/sync-download-checksums.mjs, wire postUpgradeTasks + RENOVATE_ALLOWED_COMMANDS, migrate config:base -> config:recommended and fileMatch -> managerFilePatterns) and FEAT-003, both still 'pending' and both unblocked by this baseline. Out-of-band items that code cannot fix from here, per context.json: stale branch renovate/nousresearch-hermes-agent-2026.x must be deleted remotely then renovate.yml re-run (no push rights in this sandbox), duplicate Dependency Dashboard issues #1/#4, and the manual renovate.yml re-run required by AGENTS.md after any Renovate config change.
